diagnosis: The Remix loader generates an AWS S3 presigned URL for a security camera video clip based on params.clipId without verifying that the authenticated user owns the security camera associated with the video clip. Any authenticated user can view private home surveillance clips of other users.
exploit_request:
GET /cameras/clip_livingroom_cam_881902 HTTP/1.1
Host: smartcam.iotportal.com
Cookie: auth_jwt=attacker_session_token
